objective.text: Distinguish encoded and decoded path representations.

difficulty.rationale: Select the decoded representation without accidentally decoding it twice.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: The request URL is https://example.test/manual/a%20b. No proxy rewrites it. Which pair do path() and decodedPath() return?

options.rationale: Both helpers return the path without the leading slash for this non-root path.
options.misconception: Both helpers return the path without the leading slash for this non-root path.

options.rationale: Percent decoding turns %20 into a space; it does not insert a plus sign.
options.misconception: Percent decoding turns %20 into a space; it does not insert a plus sign.

options.rationale: path retains percent encoding and trims the surrounding slash; decodedPath decodes the encoded space.
path does not perform the additional percent decoding applied by decodedPath.
options.misconception: path does not perform the additional percent decoding applied by decodedPath.
